name: Giardia lamblia (giardiasis)
short_description: Binucleate flagellated protozoan (genus Giardia, also called G. duodenalis / G. intestinalis) whose bilaterally symmetric, teardrop-shaped trophozoite (~12-15 x 5-9 um) carries two symmetric anterior nuclei giving it a famously face-like look, a large concave ventral adhesive disc that clamps onto small-intestinal enterocytes, a median body of microtubules, and eight flagella in four bilateral pairs (anterior, posterolateral, ventral, caudal); it does not invade tissue but coats the mucosa, blunts villi and interferes with fat/vitamin absorption, and encysts into an oval four-nucleated environmentally resistant cyst that is shed in faeces and survives in untreated water, making it the classic 'backpacker's/beaver fever' waterborne diarrhoeal parasite.

textbook.1: ❌ REJECTED (gemini-2.5-flash-image) — superficially attractive but fails the single most checkable fact: roughly 14-16 free flagellar tips instead of eight, drawn as a dense mane around the whole body. Outlines are also heavy black cartoon strokes rather than the thin clean house line, and the cell reads as a goofy character. Fix: escalate model, specify four NAMED pairs and an exact count of eight free tips, demand fine line weight.
textbook.2: ⚠️ PARTIAL (gemini-3-pro-image) — big improvement: clean bilaterally symmetric upright teardrop, two equal symmetric nuclei with karyosomes, one solid circular spiral-ridged ventral disc with no false 'mouth' aperture, claw-shaped median body correctly INSIDE the body on the midline, thin elegant outlines, muted dusty palette on charcoal, full bleed, no text. But only SIX free flagellar tips: the ventral pair stayed hidden as internal axonemes. Fix: require all four pairs to emerge and trail outside the silhouette.
textbook.3: ✅ PASS (gemini-3-pro-image) — CHOSEN as the label base. Same clean symmetric teardrop and correct internal anatomy as attempt 2, now with EXACTLY EIGHT free flagellar tips, verified by pixel-sampling the background: four on each side (anterior at y≈440, posterolateral and ventral at y≈780, caudal sweeping at y≈940). Two symmetric nuclei with central karyosomes, one solid circular ventral adhesive disc with fine spiral ridges and no aperture, claw-shaped median body on the midline fully inside the cytoplasm. Thin clean outlines, muted educational palette, neutral charcoal background filling the frame, no border, no baked-in text.

sem.1: ❌ REJECTED (gemini-2.5-flash-image) — the two nuclei are offset diagonally instead of mirrored either side of the midline, destroying the bilateral symmetry that is the whole teaching point; the adhesive disc is drawn as a bilobed heart/horseshoe rather than a round concave basin; internal structures show through, which an SEM cannot do; flagella count off. Fix: escalate, demand surface-only opaque rendering, a ROUND disc basin, and eight counted tips.
sem.2: ✅ PASS (gemini-3-pro-image) — CHOSEN. Photorealistic false-colour SEM plate, single specimen on a plain textured substrate, warm gold body against cool teal-grey. Opaque surface only — no internal organelles visible, which is correct for SEM. The ventral adhesive disc reads as a large ROUND, shallow concave basin with fine concentric ridges (not a hole, not heart-shaped), and two subtle symmetric dorsal swellings hint at the underlying nuclei. EXACTLY EIGHT free flagellar tips counted across the two half-frames. Fills the frame, no border, no text or scale bar.

reference: ✅ PASS — CDC Public Health Image Library #8698 (CDC / Janice Haney Carr), public domain: 'This image is in the public domain and thus free of any copyright restrictions.' Viewed and confirmed to be a genuine, single, cleanly isolated Giardia lamblia trophozoite — pear/teardrop outline, a clearly concave ventral face where the adhesive disc sits, and several long trailing flagella against a plain black background, with no other specimens and no clumping. NATIVE SIZE 700x876 px (35 KB lores JPEG); fetch_reference.py performed a plain deterministic letterboxed resize to 1080x1080, so the displayed image is UPSCALED from a small original and is soft — this is stated rather than dressed up. No baked-in text or scale bar was present, so edit_image.py was deliberately skipped: nothing was re-illustrated, re-framed or invented. Honest caveats: the plate is greyscale, not false-coloured, and because several flagella overlap and loop close to the body it is not possible to count all eight individually in this single frame.
